title: 第4章 流言
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

于是帝乙的祖父，时任商王武乙西征，不顾江河日下的国力，击败了蚕丛。

蚕丛退位，去王号，传位柏灌，柏灌又传位鱼凫，两代称臣纳贡，休养生息，重新壮大国力，积蓄实力，仍旧是巴蜀之地内的诸侯之长。

灌江口，就是蜀侯治下的领地，借助水网交通之便利，也是他们这附近诸多地区最繁华的地方。

“还有，就在你和杨戬出去的时候，杨家也正好来信，要找你多进些琥珀晶糖。“

“哦？若有时间，我倒也正好去一趟灌江口，上次去的匆忙，未曾言明，我倒是想请杨家，与我家扩大这琥珀晶糖的代售生意，

祁澜接过竹简，简单看了几眼后放下道。

祁云不懂得市场这个词，但也能明白其意，顿时皱起了眉头。

“澜儿，为父不晓得你为何如此重视这灌江口杨家，连你这开创的琥珀晶糖，都要找杨家一起卖，他家纵使有些不俗，可依我家之能与这琥珀晶糖之妙，也不愁销路，更不愁守不住这赚来的财富。“

“父亲，孩儿自有谋算，这杨家可没您想的那么简单，我虽与杨戬交好，也看中他兄弟二人之能，但我要的，可不止是这些。”

祁澜放下竹简，喝了一口茶，笑着道。

这所谓的琥珀晶糖，其实就是黄冰糖，只是起了个好名字而已。

在这个时代，有的只是些最原始的饴糖，祁澜也吃过，大体上是一种粘牙、微微发酸，混有杂味的麦芽糖，其他的便是一些果脯蜜饯，是甜味的主要来源。

得益于上辈子刷了不少短视频，还是个三流网文写手，各种乱七八糟的没用知识记了不少，反而在这时候派上了用场，改进了制作饴糖的工艺。

也就是选择刚发芽的麦子，研磨细腻之后，与蒸熟的蜀黍放入陶罐中搅拌封闭，至于阴凉处，避免露天发酵减少其他杂菌。

糖化后就已经是超出这个时代的上等饴糖。

之后再放入铜釜中慢熬，静置沉淀，自然便能凝出结晶状的黄冰糖，剩下的下层糖浆，也能拿来制作普通饴糖和点心。

这等冰糖一出世，自然大受欢迎，已经开始慢慢在蜀地之中流行。

今年他们长溪部进献给商王的朝贡之中，也有最上等，颜色最清透的黄冰糖。

至于为何要分利给灌江口杨家……

前世记忆中那段家喻户晓的神话，如烙印般刻在他的脑海。旁人只知杨家神秘，杨戬杨蛟兄弟神力过人，可谁又能想到，那杨家主母乃天帝之妹，是真正的云上仙神！

这才是他甘愿分出琥珀晶糖巨大利润的真正原因。与凡俗的财富相比，一条能通往仙道的线索，才是无价之宝。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

So Emperor Yi's grandfather, Wu Yi, the Shang king at that time, went to the west and defeated Cancong regardless of the declining national power.

Cancong abdicated, lost the title of king, and passed to Baiguan, who in turn passed to Yufu. For two generations, he became a vassal and paid tribute, recuperated, re-strengthened the country, accumulated strength, and was still the leader of the princes in Bashu.

The mouth of the Guanjiang River is the territory under the rule of the Marquis of Shu. With the convenience of water network transportation, it is also the most prosperous place in many nearby areas.

"Also, just when you and Yang Jian were going out, the Yang family also sent a letter asking you to buy more amber crystal candies."

"Oh? If I have time, I would just like to go to Guanjiangkou. I was in a hurry last time, so I didn't say it clearly. I would like to invite the Yang family to expand the amber crystal candy sales business with my family.

Qi Lan took the bamboo slip, looked at it briefly and put it down.

Qi Yun didn't understand the word market, but he could understand its meaning and immediately frowned.

"Lan'er, I don't know why you attach so much importance to the Yang family in Guanjiangkou. You even want to sell the amber crystal candy you created with the Yang family. Even though their family is a bit good, with the ability of my family and the wonders of this amber crystal candy, we don't have to worry about sales, let alone the wealth we have earned."

"Father, children have their own plans. The Yang family is not as simple as you think. Although I have a good relationship with Yang Jian, and I also like the abilities of his two brothers, I want more than that."

Qi Lan put down the bamboo slips, took a sip of tea, and said with a smile.

This so-called amber crystal candy is actually yellow rock candy, just a good name.

In this era, there were only the most primitive maltose, and Qi Lan had also eaten it. Generally speaking, it was a kind of sticky, slightly sour, and mixed-flavored maltose. The others were some preserved fruits, which were the main source of sweetness.

Thanks to the fact that I watched a lot of short videos in my previous life and was a third-rate online writer, I memorized a lot of useless knowledge, which came in handy at this time and improved the process of making caramel.

That is to say, choose newly germinated wheat, grind it finely, put it into a clay pot with steamed sorghum, stir and seal it, and place it in a cool place to avoid open-air fermentation to reduce other miscellaneous bacteria.

After saccharification, it becomes a high-quality malt sugar that is beyond this era.

After that, it is slowly boiled in a copper kettle and left to settle, and crystallized yellow rock sugar will naturally condense. The remaining lower syrup can also be used to make ordinary malt candies and snacks.

As soon as this kind of rock candy came out, it was naturally very popular, and it has gradually begun to become popular in Sichuan.

This year, among the tribute presented to King Shang by the Changxi Tribe, there was also the finest yellow rock candy with the clearest color.

As for why the profits should be distributed to the Yang family in Guanjiangkou...

The well-known myth in his past life memory was engraved in his mind like a brand.Others only know that the Yang family is mysterious and that brothers Yang Jian and Yang Jiao have extraordinary powers, but who would have thought that the mistress of the Yang family is the sister of the Emperor of Heaven and is the real immortal deity on the clouds!

This was the real reason why he was willing to share the huge profits from Amber Crystal Candy.Compared with mundane wealth, a clue that leads to the immortal path is a priceless treasure.
